verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina/probability/version-sensitive fields as null or descriptive text.
research_scope: Dynamite Kick — Strike Super mentor-training acquisition and charge mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Xenoverse documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Dynamite Kick was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Dynamite Kick as a Strike Super Attack used by Hercule.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The documented Future Warrior route is training with Hercule. The reviewed skill documentation identifies Hercule's training as the unlock source and also lists Majin Buu as a customizable partner user.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is mentor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical documentation does not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Dynamite Kick
records.skill_description: A chargeable close-range kick that becomes substantially stronger when fully charged.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a stance followed by a right-leg kick. The move can be charged through multiple stages; full charge produces the strongest documented version. Because the charge leaves the user vulnerable and exact current timing is version-sensitive, no fixed frame or damage values are promoted here.
records.acquisition_notes: Hercule training is the canonical Future Warrior acquisition route. Majin Buu customization availability is retained as character metadata rather than treated as a separate acquisition identity.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Chargeable short-range Strike Super with substantial commitment during charging; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
